must.title: Security
must.description: Ensure the system is secure against common vulnerabilities.
must.metric: No critical vulnerabilities in SAST reports.
acceptance_criteria: SAST reports show no critical vulnerabilities.

must.title: Reliability
must.description: Ensure the system operates reliably under expected conditions.

should.title: Performance
should.description: Ensure the system meets performance benchmarks.
should.metric: System response time < 200ms for 95% of requests.
acceptance_criteria: Load tests show response times within limits.
Performance is consistent under peak load.

should.verification: Load test at 10× expected peak; measure p95/p99.

should.title: Usability
should.description: Ensure the system is user-friendly and accessible.
acceptance_criteria: User feedback is collected and analyzed.
UI is intuitive and easy to navigate.

should.title: Observability
should.description: Implement observability to monitor system health.
should.metric: All critical metrics are monitored in real-time.
acceptance_criteria: Alerts are configured for critical metrics.
